categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: LNG application equipment, heavy equipment manufacturing, and LNG processing, operation, and sales services. Its product portfolio includes liquefaction plant devices, LNG/CNG refueling station equipment, cryogenic transport vehicles, LNG storage tanks, LNG supply systems for vehicles and ships, cryogenic valves, chemical and marine engineering pressure vessels, and LNG ship tanks. The company also provides integrated technical solutions and operation and maintenance services across the LNG industry chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced cryogenic technology, pressure vessel manufacturing, and LNG supply system design. It employs proprietary technologies in LNG liquefaction, storage, and transportation, including vacuum insulated tanks and specialized valves. The firm emphasizes R&D in hydrogen fuel cell vehicle liquid hydrogen supply systems, liquid hydrogen and helium container development, and LNG cold energy recovery systems. Manufacturing follows strict quality and safety certifications aligned with international standards such as ASME, DNV, BV, and others.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include heavy truck manufacturers like FAW Jiefang, Dongfeng Commercial Vehicle, China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, and Shaanxi Automobile Group. The company also serves major oil and gas enterprises such as PetroChina, Sinopec, and CNOOC, as well as global energy giants like Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, and Total. Its markets span LNG heavy trucks, LNG ship fuel systems, and energy infrastructure projects, targeting transportation, petrochemical, and energy sectors domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant domestic sales accounting for over 70% of revenue. It has expanded its overseas presence with subsidiaries and projects in Japan, Australia, Brazil, Singapore, Spain, and other international markets. The overseas business focuses on LNG heavy equipment and energy service operations, leveraging global energy infrastructure investments and LNG demand growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the LNG supply chain. It manufactures LNG liquefaction and storage equipment, LNG transport vehicles, and refueling systems, and provides LNG processing and operation services. It acts as a key equipment supplier and service provider within the LNG industry chain, integrating manufacturing with energy operation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding LNG application equipment market share, enhancing heavy equipment manufacturing capabilities, and growing LNG energy operation services domestically and internationally. The company invests heavily in R&D focusing on hydrogen fuel cell vehicle liquid hydrogen supply systems, LNG cold energy recovery, and advanced cryogenic technologies. It also pursues digital transformation, automation, and intelligent manufacturing to improve product competitiveness and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct product sales of LNG equipment, heavy equipment, and related components. Additionally, the company earns income from LNG sales and operation and maintenance services. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales channels, including bidding and negotiated contracts with industrial and energy sector clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's LNG equipment manufacturing sector and has established a strong brand in heavy equipment manufacturing and LNG energy services. It competes with domestic and international suppliers of LNG liquefaction, storage, and transport equipment. Its inclusion in global energy companies' approved supplier lists and recognition by major clients like Wärtsilä and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries underscore its competitive standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.32 billion, a 9.34% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 219 million, up 49.02%. Total assets stood at about RMB 4.05 billion with net assets of RMB 2.19 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding domestic and international markets and enhanced operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive LNG industry chain solutions, integrating advanced cryogenic technology, high-quality manufacturing, and intelligent operation services. Its products are certified to international standards, ensuring safety and reliability. The firm differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, innovative hydrogen fuel cell system development, and a mature energy service business model that combines equipment manufacturing with operation and maintenance, providing customers with end-to-end solutions.
